title: Onyx Hash — Flat Icon Grid Portfolio
description: A pure-black, zero-gradient template anchored by a four-cell vibrant geometric icon grid and an edge-to-edge orange footer band. The hashtag-prefixed display headline sets it apart from conventional dark portfolios through flat-color, social-native graphic language.
philosophy: This template exists for designers and technologists who treat their portfolio as a statement, not a document. It refuses gradients, soft shadows, and serif type entirely — every element is a flat block of maximal contrast and deliberate color. The hashtag prefix reframes professional credentials in a contemporary digital-native register, borrowing fluency from social platforms without sacrificing authority. It is built for a speaker who commands the room through bold graphic clarity rather than atmospheric decoration.
goodFor: Creative technologist and UX designer portfolio decks
Conference speaker intro and bio opener slides
Hashtag-style section dividers and chapter title cards
Case study title slides demanding immediate high-contrast impact
avoidFor: Data-heavy quarterly reviews requiring multiple embedded chart types
Academic or research presentations where serif credibility cues matter
Clients with light-branded, pastel, or soft corporate visual identities
Long-form body-copy or document-style report slides
author: harness

examples.promptCore: This title slide is a personal brand broadcast — the visual language of a social-native identity card translated into presentation format. A tight quad-grid of flat geometric icons saturates the upper-right corner with hard-edged color blocks against absolute black, creating immediate asymmetric tension with the sparse left-side text column. The hashtag prefix on the headline collapses the distance between professional credential and digital identity. The footer band is a blunt hard stop, not a decorative flourish. Avoid all softness: no gradients, no drop shadows, no rounded corners, no transitional elements of any kind.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed black canvas on a 12-column grid with a tight 6% outer margin. The 2×2 geometric icon grid occupies cols 8–12 flush to the top edge, acting as a vivid right-side anchor. The hashtag-prefixed display headline and subtitle stack left-aligned in cols 1–7, vertically centered in the upper body zone. An edge-to-edge horizontal footer band runs the full canvas width at the bottom, containing the name/role line with no additional padding beyond the standard baseline grid.

examples.promptCore: The slide feels like a social-platform feature card crossed with a brutalist product grid — loud, declarative, and entirely flat. Four modular cells carry equal visual weight, each a solid vibrant block detonating against the pure black field; the composition is dense-modular with no breathing room between cells yet generous void above the grid. Every shape must be a hard geometric block — no gradients, no shadows, no decorative curves. The mood is maximalist through raw color contrast alone, never through ornamentation.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid; a 2×2 flat-color icon cell grid bleeds edge-to-edge across all columns with zero outer margin, each cell housing a geometric icon above a two-line label. A hashtag-prefixed section identifier sits top-left within an 8% inset margin above the grid. The full-width accent footer band occupies the bottom strip and carries a short descriptor or page counter flush right. Vertical hierarchy is enforced entirely by cell color contrast and icon scale — no rule lines, no header band.
